request.question: What would be affected if resolve_semantic_fks changed? List every function that calls it directly or indirectly, with the shortest call depth, outside the tests.
request.evidence: Follow resolved calls backwards from the callee to its callers, recursively. Calls include callback references (call_kind 'callback'), where a function is passed to another call such as asyncio.to_thread(f, x). Overridden methods called through a base class (self._run_once() in a base class) are not followed to the subclass.

gold_sql:
WITH RECURSIVE impact(symbol_id, depth) AS (
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN code.symbols t ON t.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
  WHERE t.name = 'resolve_semantic_fks'
  UNION
  SELECT c.caller_symbol_id, i.depth + 1
  FROM code.calls c
  JOIN impact i ON c.callee_symbol_id = i.symbol_id
  WHERE i.depth < 6
)
SELECT i.symbol_id, MIN(i.depth) AS depth
FROM impact i
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = i.symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
WHERE NOT f.is_test
GROUP BY i.symbol_id
ORDER BY depth, i.symbol_id;
